William Blake (1757–1827).  The Poetical Works.  1908.

Gnomic Verses

Riches

XX
T
HE COUNTLESS
 gold of a merry heart,
The rubies and pearls of a loving eye,
The indolent
 never can bring to the mart,
Nor the secret hoard up in his treasury.
